description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component of a media client, specifically testing data handling, need data events, and segment addition in various states and scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineDataTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the media pipeline's data handling, need data events, and segment addition logic.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline, sets up shared memory info, attaches source, and sets default playback state.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, deletes frames, destroys media pipeline, and resets mocks.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source with a specified source ID to the media pipeline.

methods.name: needDataGeneric
methods.description: Triggers a generic need data request with current source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: addFrames
methods.description: Adds a specified number of frames of a given media source type with provided data to the media pipeline.

methods.name: deleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all stored frames from the internal vector.

methods.name: haveDataSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful haveData call, expecting the media pipeline to report data availability.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a media segment frame of specified type, data, and timestamp.

methods.name: startAddSegmentThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that adds a media segment to the pipeline, simulating asynchronous data addition.
